scenes.tts: A pill taken for acne can change how a baby's face forms. How can a drug for the skin reach the face? Look at the hindbrain of an early embryo. It shows a row of small bulges, called rhombomeres. Early on, their cells look much alike. Yet r two will make the motor neurons that work the jaw, and r four those that move the face. Each bulge needs an address.

scenes.visual: Pill and a baby-face outline with a question mark; hindbrain strip of seven similar bulges; r2 and r4 light up with jaw and face labels; blank address tags appear on every bulge.

scenes.tts: The address starts with a vitamin A product, retinoic acid. An enzyme called Raldh two makes it in tissue beside the hindbrain and spinal cord. Enzymes called Cyp twenty-six destroy it toward the front. Think of a bath with the tap at one end and the drain at the other. Retinoic acid ends up high toward the back of the hindbrain and low toward the front.

scenes.visual: Strip of bulges with front on the left; a Raldh2 tap chip appears at the back, a Cyp26 drain chip at the front; orange drops flow forward and vanish at the drain; a gradient curve grows, high at the back, low at the front.

scenes.tts: Retinoic acid is small and oily, so it reaches the nucleus. There it binds a receptor called R A R. The receptor pairs with another one, R X R, on a short stretch of DNA. Hox A one and Hox B one carry such stretches. When the pair sits there, the gene comes on.
scenes.caption: Retinoic acid is small and oily, so it reaches the nucleus. There it binds a receptor called RAR. The receptor pairs with another one, RXR, on a short stretch of DNA. Hoxa1 and Hoxb1 carry such stretches. When the pair sits there, the gene comes on.
scenes.visual: A large nucleus; an orange retinoic acid dot crosses its edge, binds an RAR chip, which pairs with an RXR chip; the pair lands on a short marked stretch of a DNA line beside the Hoxa1 and Hoxb1 genes, which switch on.
scenes.narration: Retinoic acid is small and oily, so it reaches the nucleus. There it binds a receptor called RAR. The receptor pairs with another one, RXR, on a short stretch of DNA. Hoxa1 and Hoxb1 carry such stretches. When the pair sits there, the gene comes on.

scenes.tts: Hox genes sit in a row on a chromosome, and they obey a rule. Their order along the chromosome matches the order of their front edges along the body. Genes at the three prime end reach farthest forward. Genes toward the five prime end stop farther back. In cells in a dish, three prime genes respond to lower doses of retinoic acid. So where the signal is lower, fewer genes come on, and they are the three prime ones.

So where the signal is lower, fewer genes come on, and they are the 3′ ones.
scenes.visual: A row of four Hox genes labelled group 1 to 4 from the 3 prime end to the 5 prime end; below it the strip of bulges, and each gene draws a bar from its front edge back; the order matches. Then a low-signal bracket at the front lights only the group 1 bar.

scenes.tts: Each rhombomere ends up with its own mix of Hox proteins. That mix is its address. It decides which nerve the segment builds. In the chick, r two and r three make the trigeminal nerve, for chewing. R four and r five make the facial nerve, for facial expression.
scenes.caption: Each rhombomere ends up with its own mix of Hox proteins. That mix is its address. It decides which nerve the segment builds. In the chick, r2 and r3 make the trigeminal nerve, for chewing. R4 and r5 make the facial nerve, for facial expression.
scenes.visual: The bars from the last scene stack into a code of marks on each bulge; the blank address tags from scene one fill with these marks; r2 and r3 take the trigeminal colour, r4 and r5 the facial colour, each with its nerve label.
scenes.narration: Each rhombomere ends up with its own mix of Hox proteins. That mix is its address. It decides which nerve the segment builds. In the chick, r2 and r3 make the trigeminal nerve, for chewing. R4 and r5 make the facial nerve, for facial expression.

scenes.tts: Now change the signal. In mouse embryos given extra retinoic acid early, the Hox domains changed. Rhombomeres two and three were transformed toward the identity of four and five. The address follows the signal. In early pregnancy, extra retinoic acid shifts the Hox code of the hindbrain. That fits how a pill for the skin can disturb the face. Too little vitamin A harms the embryo as well. The dose has to be right in both directions.

scenes.visual: Extra orange drops raise the gradient; the Hox marks slide forward and r2 and r3 change to the r4 and r5 colours; a dose bar appears with a green window in the middle and red zones too low and too high.
